note: Synthetic example. Names and node IDs are illustrative. Times only; no date was given.

messages.author: Joonas Kemppainen
messages.text: Helena, I replaced the QSFP on XC-318. The port comes up locally but there is no traffic and the LOS alarm is still lit on the far end.

messages.author: Helena Ketola
messages.text: Is the far-end alarm active now or cleared? Sometimes it takes a minute.

messages.author: Joonas Kemppainen
messages.text: Still active on the far end. The local end says link up.

messages.author: Helena Ketola
messages.text: Asymmetric then. On the XC-4 line cards from 2021, revision C, the transmit laser stays disabled after a hot swap until the card is power cycled. Which revision is yours?

messages.author: Helena Ketola
messages.text: Power cycle the line card from the controller. Only that card, not the whole shelf. Jaana did something similar on the XC-2 units last year if you need more details.

messages.author: Ismo Vainio
messages.text: Heads up all, the VPN has been slow all morning.

messages.author: Joonas Kemppainen
messages.text: The card is rebooting, it takes about ten minutes.

messages.author: Helena Ketola
messages.text: Let me know how it goes.
